e: From the Roman numeral C (“100”) (which was printed on it) + note. Attested from the 1920s.
q: If he ran now, leaving Zygmunt to forfeit the hundred, he'd have to stay on the run. It would be the super's c-note Zygmunt had put up, he wouldn't be able to go back to work on Division Street till he'd squared that hundred.
1949, Nelson Algren, The Man with the Golden Arm:
"They c'n go loose and rape up the countryside for all of 'em who run this county care," was one obscure observation we met....
